entities.summary: Otto Eisler was a Czech architect, noted for his contributions to International style in architecture. He was Jewish and is a survivor of the Auschwitz death camp. Otto Eisler was a architects & engineers from Bystřice nad Pernštejnem (1893-06-01, Bystřice nad Pernštejnem–1968-07-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
